name: malikadai-bill-android
description: Android Tamil/Tanglish/English voice grocery billing with PDF confirmation preview, blue app theme and compact single-row header.

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android:debug: npm run build && (test -d android || npx cap add android) && npm run icons && npx cap sync android && node scripts/prepare-android-manifest.mjs && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.verify: npm test && node --check scripts/prepare-android-manifest.mjs && node --check src/voice-ui.js && node --check src/voice-parser.js && node --check src/mobile-bridge.js && node --check server/transcription-server.mjs
